entities.summary: Cecilia Zandalasini is an Italian basketball player for the Golden State Valkyries of the Women's National Basketball Association (WNBA) and for Famila Basket Schio of the Lega Basket Femminile. She also plays for the Italian national team. She was the MVP of 2016 FIBA Europe Under-20 Championship for Women.
